name: Stitchwork: Night Quilt
tagline: The village is a whole-cloth quilt made for a night in the woods, and the Wolf is the patch sewn under one of the labels.

fonts.display: Fraunces 800-900 with SOFT 100 (titles as cream felt appliqué with a couched gold-cord outline; the room code and +100 in gold satin stitch); Fraunces italic for captions and roles
fonts.ui: Figtree 700-800 for buttons, chips and fields

motifs: Whole-cloth quilting in cream running stitch with real relief: echo rings rippling out from the moon (and from the Wolf on the reveal), quilted pines, crosshatch and clamshells
Room code in gold satin stitch on indigo velvet inside a pieced flying-geese border with lantern-felt cornerstones
Appliquéd felt moon with gold blanket stitch; gold star stitches scattered across the sky
A lantern lights on the gold-thread garland for every villager who arrives; English paper-pieced hexies for avatars
Countdown as a seam being unpicked: one gold stitch pulled per second, needle holes left behind
reveal: The Wolf's label is unpicked along its quilting line and drops away on its last thread, leaving a darker footprint ringed with needle holes and a seam ripper beside it; underneath, the charcoal-and-indigo Wolf patch sits in a pool of moonlight with its gold-thread eyes glinting while the quilting ripples out from it, and the real answer gets a pleated gold-and-copper rosette reading 'The real Maya'.
why: Deep indigo ground with cream and gold thread keeps glare low in a dark room while the code, labels and lantern-felt buttons stay high-contrast from across it. The only warm light on screen marks what matters (arrivals, actions, the Wolf's eyes), so the room's attention goes exactly where the game needs it.
